head: PocketBuddy: budgets and net worth with an AI that knows your numbers
dek: PocketBuddy links your bank accounts, cards, loans and brokerages, sorts your spending and tracks net worth, and lets you ask an AI advisor about your real numbers.
details: You can import history from Mint or Monarch. Bank access is read-only through Plaid, with no ads or data selling, according to the maker. It costs $9.99 a month or $79 a year, with a 14-day trial and a live demo without an account.
means: If you want a budget app that answers questions like "where did my money go?", this is a new option with a free trial.
todo: Try the demo on its site before linking your accounts.
